A Class English ✦ Unit 3

History of the Post

STAMP DETECTIVE CHALLENGE · Interactive team game

CLASSROOM
CHALLENGE
★ ★ ★
Look carefully at the stamp collage. Give clues about the pictures, colours and writing. Can your classmates find the correct stamp and identify what it shows and where it comes from?
🧩 16 stamps👥 2–4 teams📡 Works offline

🕵️ How to play

1Divide the class into two to four teams. A teacher or a student from another team becomes the clue-giver.
2The clue-giver secretly chooses a stamp and gives spoken or written clues, without saying its number.
3The guessing team taps the correct stamp on the big collage, then guesses its subject and country of origin.
4Earn 3 points for identifying the stamp, 2 points for the subject and 1 point for the country. Rotate teams for the next round.
The country means where the stamp was issued, not necessarily the place or event shown. Each task is checked immediately and its correct answer is shown at the end of the round.

⚙️ Set up your game

💬 Useful language for clues
I can see…The main colour is…There is / There are…At the top / bottom…It looks like…It might be from…It shows…I think it is stamp…

🔎 Find the mystery stamp

Tap a numbered circle to make your guess.
Numbered circles refer to stamps, not the surrounding envelopes or postmarks. The two javelin stamps and the two blue bird designs are separate targets. Take a close look!

Clue-giver’s turn

Clue-giver: choose one stamp privately.

You may also describe the stamp aloud. Ask the guessing team to look away while you choose it.

🎯 Which stamp matches these clues?

Look at the collage and tap one numbered stamp.

✅ You found the stamp! Now investigate it.

Choose an answer in each question. Each is checked immediately.

1. What is the main subject of the stamp? (+2)

2. Which country issued the stamp? (+1)

🔍 Mystery solved!

Origin:

Teacher’s tip: Invite students to give richer clues before tapping the collage: colours, figures, position, symbols, text and estimated period. The speaker can come from a different team.
